reason_for_supersession: Direct raw OONI harvesting of the exact AS50223/www.tiktok.com case showed DNS-level blocking rather than TLS interference. The earlier use of the country-level OONI finding as if it described this exact AS/endpoint pair was too broad.

confirmed_background.protei_deployment: PROTEI states that its DPI platform entered commercial traffic operation on MegaCom in June 2014.
confirmed_background.filtering_integration: PROTEI states that in 2015 MegaCom integrated Entensys/UserGate Web Filter classification with PROTEI DPI policy enforcement.
confirmed_background.these_facts_do_not_prove: that every later censorship event or DNS/TLS failure on AS50223 is produced by PROTEI

relation_to_ooni_country_finding.country_level: OONI reported that most Kyrgyzstan TikTok measurements across multiple endpoints and five tested networks showed TLS sessions timing out after ClientHello.
relation_to_ooni_country_finding.exact_as_endpoint_level: The harvested AS50223/www.tiktok.com sample did not reproduce that mechanism because DNS failed first.
relation_to_ooni_country_finding.rule: COUNTRY-LEVEL MAJORITY MECHANISM MUST NOT BE IMPUTED TO A SPECIFIC ASN/ENDPOINT WITHOUT RAW CONFIRMATION

next_test: Harvest multiple TikTok app endpoints on AS50223 that OONI tested during the April 2024 block and isolate any raw measurements that reach TCP/TLS. Compare those with other Kyrgyz ASNs under the same national policy and with non-PROTEI controls.
